name: TiDB Cloud

evidence.sql: C02: distributed SQL database is the primary type; D01: MySQL-compatible distributed SQL
evidence.vector: V01: preview vector search on Cloud Starter and self-hosted v8.4+, up to 16,383 dimensions

line: Managed distributed SQL with optional vector search and a self-hosted Community edition.

free.text: MySQL: 5 instances get 5GiB row + 5GiB column, 50M RUs/mo; no idle rule

cells.regions: AWS, Google Cloud and Azure; availability varies by plan

sql.math: 1 GB fits the row allowance, but 100,000 reads and 20,000 writes do not show the total RUs (request units).
Kept storage can fit the free allowance. Background RUs (request units) are unknown, so the idle total is incomplete.

files.math: $101.50–129 at published rates, minus the shared $5 allowance. The storage tier and metadata are unknown.

jobs.math: TiDB has no matching app-worker product for the 10,000-job workload.
